messages:
Jordan Patel: Hey — quick heads up, I've been having a lot of trouble with fluorescent lights and long stretches of screen time this month. It's making focus really hard. Can we discuss accommodations? I'd prefer to keep this private for now. Thanks.

Mike Chen: Thanks for flagging, Jordan. I can help coordinate. @Anya — can you advise next steps? I can free up time this afternoon to sync.

Anya Lopez: Hi Jordan — thanks for letting us know. We can absolutely support this. Quick Q: do you want to DM or keep convo here? Either works.

Anya Lopez: High level process: 1) temporary adjustments can be made immediately (monitor hood, blue-light filter, headphones, meeting cadence reduction), 2) for formal accommodation we usually ask for a short clinician note + the accommodation request form (link: https://redwood.internal/accom-form). Timeline after docs is typically 5-7 business days for review.

Jordan Patel: DM is fine. For now I'd like noise-cancelling headphones + fewer back-to-back meetings and maybe a couple remote days per week if approved. Also curious — will this affect my performance review or promotion path?

Anya Lopez: Noise-cancelling headphones and reduced meetings are reasonable temporary steps; I'll put in a request to Procurement for headphones while we collect docs. On reviews: accommodations are not a negative factor. We do not use accommodation requests as basis for adverse performance actions. If workload needs to be redistributed temporarily, we'll coordinate with your manager.

Mike Chen: I removed Jordan from the recurring planning sync this week and will cover the key items. Jordan, if you need me to decline more meetings on your calendar, say the word.

Jordan Patel: Appreciate it, Mike. One more thing — do I need to use the company doctor or can my external clinician write the note?

Anya Lopez: External clinicians are fine. The note should indicate functional limitations and suggested accommodations (brief is fine). Send it to accommodations@redwood.com or DM me and I'll upload it for you. If you prefer, we can do an intake call.

Jordan Patel: I'll DM you the note tonight. Thanks for the quick help.

AccommodationsBot: Received: accommodation request form submitted for Jordan Patel (ID: ACC-20260301-47). Temporary adjustments noted: meeting cadence reduction, headphone purchase initiated.

Jordan Patel: :relieved: thanks everyone.

Anya Lopez: I'll follow up once the review is complete and share the formal accommodation plan. In the meantime, please let Mike or me know if anything else would help. :handshake:
